name: OCEAN FAIR INTERNATIONAL SHIP CHANDLEING LLC
brief_text:
Four detectors flagged Ocean Fair International Ship Chandlering LLC. Benford's Law analysis revealed severe distortion in leading-digit frequencies across 3,544 transactions, with digits 3 and 4 appearing far more often than expected and digit 1 substantially underrepresented. Modification growth on contract SPE30024D4004 expanded at 2,952 times its initial value, roughly 12 times faster than peer companies in perishable food manufacturing. An Isolation Forest multivariate analysis scored the entity as a statistical outlier, driven primarily by extreme concentration in a single awarding agency and near-zero competitive bidding. Sole-source awards comprised 98.1 percent of all transactions, compared to a peer median of zero percent.

The Benford test yielded a KS statistic of 0.188 with p-value 4.1e-109 across all 3,544 awards. The modification growth z-score reached 4.59 sigmas, with the flagged contract growing at a ratio of 2,952 versus a NAICS average of 237. Sole-source concentration deviated 2.84 sigmas above the peer group norm. Lifetime obligated value totaled 268.2 million dollars.

These statistical anomalies warrant scrutiny but do not confirm fraud. The entity's NAICS classification as perishable food manufacturing appears misaligned with its name referencing ship chandlering, which may explain some peer-group comparisons. The single-agency concentration and high sole-source ratio could reflect legitimate specialized contracting relationships with DoD. The small peer cohort of 23 entities in this NAICS code limits statistical power. Benford deviations can arise from genuine business patterns rather than manipulation.
